items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of preliminary influent bar screening with a Parshall flume and ultrasonic level sensor
an aeration basin divided into two equally sized cells
Two 2.5-acre evaporation and percolation ponds are provided to receive effluent from the aeration basin
a horizontal pressure filter...The multi-media filtration, chlorination, and dechlorination units only operate during periods of discharge to the South Fork of Battle Creek
